name: Rotary CAM
author: Stefan
description: Simultaneous 4th-axis rotary CAM: open an STL or STEP part, knock the corners off square stock, rough it in spiral layers, finish it with a continuous ball-mill spiral around the A axis, clean up what the rotary passes can't reach (under overhangs, tight creases) with indexed 3+1 passes, and neck the ends for parting, with tenons on the axis holding the part to the stock. Simulate the G-code against the stock before you run it. Save the whole job as a project file. Uses your Tool Library and controller rates, posts grblHAL G-code and loads it straight into ncSender. Rotary axis parallel to X, chuck on the left.
